title: Bomboclat
blurb: A Jamaican patois exclamation that travelled far beyond Jamaica and lost almost none of its force on the way. It gets used for shock, for emphasis, and for moments that have comprehensively exceeded ordinary vocabulary. The internet adopted it as both a caption format and a reaction, often with little idea of its literal meaning or its weight as a curse. Something in the delivery survives translation completely intact. Use it dramatically, use it respectfully, and know that anybody who grew up around the word will clock exactly how you are using it.
origin: The Jamaican patois exclamation, adopted globally as a shock reaction.
